institution.title: Institution
institution.description: Name, contact details, language and branding shown to everyone.
institution.name: Institution name
institution.shortNameHelp: Shown next to “Ada” in the sidebar, e.g. an abbreviation.
institution.timezoneHelp: Used for monthly budget periods and dates.
institution.primaryColorHelp: Used for buttons and highlights. Must contrast at least 3:1 with white; a readable dark-mode variant is derived automatically.
institution.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB.
institution.faviconHelp: Square PNG, 16–512 px, up to 256 KB.
institution.budgetDisplayHelp: With “percentage only”, users never see dollar amounts; administrators still do.
institution.cap: Monthly cap for the whole institution (USD)
institution.capHelp: All users together can spend at most this much per month, whatever their own budgets. Empty = no cap.
institution.notificationEmailsHelp: One address per line. They receive the cap alerts (80 % and 100 %) and the monthly report.
institution.mailNotConfigured: E-mail is not configured on this server (MAIL_MAILER is log): messages are only written to the log. See the deployment guide.

authentication.title: Sign-in
authentication.description: Who may sign in to Ada.
authentication.allowedDomainsHelp: One domain per line. Only accounts from these domains can sign in.
authentication.autoProvision: Anyone with an address in an allowed domain can sign in
authentication.autoProvisionHelp: An account is created on their first sign-in. If turned off, only the users added under Administration → Users can sign in. Users added there can always sign in, even with an address outside the allowed domains.
authentication.noProviders: The identity provider is not configured yet. Set SAML_IDP_ENTITY_ID, SAML_IDP_SSO_URL and SAML_IDP_CERT on the server (values from the IdP metadata).
authentication.secretsNote: Identity provider settings are managed on the server (.env), not here.

saml.title: SAML single sign-on
saml.description: Enter these values in the custom SAML app of your identity provider (Google Admin → Apps → Web and mobile apps).
saml.entityId: Entity ID (also the SP metadata URL)
saml.nameIdHelp: Name ID format: {{format}}, Name ID: the user's primary e-mail. Optional attributes: first_name, last_name.

oidc.title: OpenID Connect (Microsoft Entra ID and others)
oidc.description: Register Ada as a web application at the identity provider with this redirect URI. Ada asks for the scopes shown and uses the authorization code flow with PKCE.
oidc.notConfigured: OpenID Connect is not used. To offer it, set OIDC_ENABLED, OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_CLIENT_ID and OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET on the server (docs/authentication.md).

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: AI provider accounts and their API keys.
providers.name: Name
providers.slugHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes; used in commands.
providers.baseUrlHelp: Leave empty for the official endpoint: {{url}}
providers.apiKeyHelp: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again; enter a new key to replace it.
providers.apiKeyEnv: Using the key from the server environment
providers.driverLocked: The type cannot be changed after creation.
providers.baseUrlCompatibleHelp: Required: the address that ends in /v1, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama) or http://your-server:8000/v1 (vLLM). Ada calls <address>/chat/completions.
providers.apiKeyOptional: Optional for servers without authentication (Ollama, vLLM).

models.title: Models
models.description: Concrete provider models with prices (USD per million tokens) and capabilities. Users never see these names directly.
models.providerModelIdHelp: Exactly as the provider API expects it.
models.pricingHelp: Enter 0 for self-hosted models (Ollama, vLLM): their use is recorded but does not count against budgets.
models.capabilitiesHelp: With "Images" on, users can attach images for this model. With "Files" on, PDFs are sent as files, so scanned pages and figures are read too; otherwise their text is sent. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text and code files work with every model.

hints.input: Everything sent to the model: the message, the conversation so far and the system prompt. 1,000 input tokens (≈ 750 English words) cost {{cost}}.
hints.output: The answer. A typical answer of 500 tokens (≈ 375 words) costs {{cost}}.
hints.cachedInput: Input the provider already has in its cache (e.g. a long system prompt repeated in every request). 10,000 cached tokens cost {{cost}} instead of {{full}}.
hints.cacheWrite: Storing input in the cache the first time. Writing 10,000 tokens costs {{cost}}; later reads cost the cached price.
hints.context: ≈ {{words}} English words (about {{pages}} pages). Older messages of long conversations are left out so that each request fits.
hints.maxOutput: The longest possible answer: ≈ {{words}} words, at most {{cost}}. The budget reserves this amount while an answer is generated (aliases can set a lower limit).
hints.exampleShort: Short question and answer (500 in / 300 out tokens)
hints.exampleTypical: Typical message with some history (2,000 in / 500 out)
hints.exampleLong: Long conversation or document (20,000 in / 1,000 out)
hints.perBudget: With a monthly budget of {{budget}}, a user can send about {{count}} typical messages.
hints.tokensNote: Rules of thumb: 1 token ≈ ¾ of an English word; Turkish text needs roughly 30–50 % more tokens for the same length.

models.modeEasyHelp: Choose the model; Ada fills in its official prices, context window and capabilities. Each user's monthly budget then limits how much they can use.
models.modeAdvancedHelp: Enter the prices per million tokens and the limits yourself, e.g. for models not in the catalog or negotiated prices.
models.modeNoCatalog: Ada's price catalog has no models for this provider; enter the prices yourself.
models.catalogChooseFirst: Choose a model to see its prices.
models.catalogSummary: Input {{input}} · output {{output}} per million tokens · context window {{window}} tokens.
models.catalogNextChange: The provider has announced new prices from {{date}}: input {{input}} · output {{output}} per million tokens. Ada will then show “New catalog prices” for this model.
models.catalogUpdateHelp: Ada's catalog has newer prices for this model: {{input}} in / {{output}} out per 1M tokens.

aliases.title: Model aliases
aliases.description: The choices users see in the model selector. The backing model can be swapped without changing anything for users.
aliases.name: Name ({{locale}})
aliases.systemPromptHelp: Optional institution instructions sent with every request.
aliases.showModelDetails: Show the underlying model to users
aliases.groupsHelp: Only members of the selected groups can choose this alias.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Every user belongs to one group. The group sets the monthly budget policy, the request limits and the models its members may use.
groups.name: Name
groups.defaultHelp: New users join the default group.
groups.maxConcurrentStreamsHelp: Answers one user may have generating at the same time; 1–20.
groups.aliasesHelp: Members can choose only these model aliases.
groups.applyToCurrentPeriod: Apply a changed budget policy to this month
groups.applyToCurrentPeriodHelp: Otherwise members keep this month’s limit and get the new one next month. Individual budgets are not affected.
groups.deleteConfirm: The group “{{name}}” will be removed. Only groups without members can be deleted.

budgetPolicies.title: Budget policies
budgetPolicies.description: Named monthly limits assigned to groups. There is no unlimited budget; $0 blocks usage.
budgetPolicies.name: Name
budgetPolicies.monthlyLimitHelp: Per user and calendar month in the institution’s time zone.
budgetPolicies.applyToCurrentPeriod: Apply a changed limit to this month
budgetPolicies.applyToCurrentPeriodHelp: Updates the limit of {{count}} users for the current month. Otherwise it applies from next month. Individual budgets are not affected.
budgetPolicies.deleteConfirm: The policy “{{name}}” will be removed. Policies used by a group cannot be deleted.

users.title: Users
users.description: Accounts, groups and budgets. Conversations are private and never shown here.
users.name: Name
users.groupHelp: The group sets the budget policy, request limits and models.
users.budgetHelp: Empty = the group policy ({{limit}} per month). $0 blocks usage.
users.disableHelp: Signs the user out everywhere and blocks sign-in. Nothing is deleted.
users.disabledHelp: This account is disabled and cannot sign in.
users.adjustHelp: Charges (positive) or credits (negative) this month’s budget, e.g. to refund a failed request. Recorded with your name.
users.self: This is your own account: you cannot change your own role or status.
users.protected: Only super administrators can change super administrators.
users.addHelp: Add people by e-mail address. They sign in with your identity provider; their account is linked by the address. Added addresses can sign in even if their domain is not in the allowed domains.
users.addressesHelp: One per line (or separated by commas). Optionally with a name: Grace Hopper <grace@example.edu>. Addresses that already have an account are skipped.
users.invitedHelp: Added on {{date}}; has not signed in yet.
users.removeInvitationHelp: The account has never been used and is deleted. The address can no longer sign in unless its domain is allowed.
users.accessDomains: Who can sign in: everyone with an address in {{domains}}, and the users added here.
users.accessListed: Who can sign in: only the users listed here.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Administrative changes and security events. Secrets are never recorded.
auditLog.subject: Subject

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Spending and usage from the usage ledger. Days follow the institution’s time zone.
reports.name: Name
reports.overshootsHelp: Requests that cost more than their reservation, because the provider billed more input than was counted. Raise the safety margin of the provider if this happens often.
reports.deviationHelp: Billed input tokens compared with the counted input (safety margin included). Negative: less was billed than counted. Estimated usage is left out.
reports.deviationNone: No counted requests in this range.

dashboard.atLimit: {{count}} users have used up their budget this month.
dashboard.overshoots: {{count}} requests cost more than their reservation this month.
dashboard.capResets: Renews on {{date}}. Alerts are e-mailed at 80 % and 100 %.
dashboard.capReached: The cap is reached: new requests are refused until {{date}}. Raise it in Institution settings.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: The usage notice users acknowledge and how long data is kept.
privacy.enabled: Ask users to acknowledge the notice before they start
privacy.textHelp: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. Empty = the built-in notice. The privacy and terms links from Institution settings are shown below it.
privacy.askAgainHelp: Happens automatically when the text changes. Version {{version}} is current.
privacy.retentionHelp: Deleted every night by ada:retention:prune. Usage records never contain message content.
privacy.conversationDaysHelp: Counted from the last message. Empty = keep until the user deletes them.
privacy.deletedDaysHelp: Conversations the user deleted can be restored by an operator until then. 0 = at the next run.
privacy.usageMonthsHelp: Costs and token counts for reports and budgets; at least 12.
